completed_work.summary: Bug 1 fix (failed tasks disappeared silently). Confirmed both suspected causes: (1) stage-a.yml wrote its job_id output only AFTER validation, so a pre-resolution failure left steps.req.outputs.job_id empty and the if:failure() handler swallowed the resulting write failure behind || true / a trailing true, leaving no status.json anywhere; (2) showTasks() treated an unreadable status (readStatus null) identically to a still-running task, rendering it as queued. Fixes: the req step now emits job_id + release_tag unconditionally and exits 0 with job_valid=false on bad input (hard stop moved to a dedicated Validate resolved job step); the failure handler guards on an unusable job_id, fails loudly (exit 1) when it cannot persist the error status, and its push retry loop now reports failure instead of ending in bare true; showTasks renders an unreadable status as status unavailable instead of queued; describeTaskState helper added to constants.js (also carries the Bug 3 torrent phrasing). Tests: 6 Python regression tests (workflow YAML shape + early-failure CLI write produces a readable error status for a job with no prior status) and 3 JS tests (describeTaskState, loadTaskList keeps null statuses distinct, showTasks renders status unavailable not queued).
completed_work.tests: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest discover pipeline/tests (216 passed, was 210); cd bot && npm test (82 passed, was 79)

completed_work.summary: Bug 2 fix (task labels never reclaimed; legacy and current tasks mixed). Root cause confirmed: storage.js nextLabel()/ensureTaskLabel() allocated from a monotonic tasks.next counter, removeTask() existed but nothing called it, and pipeline/cleanup/expired.py only manages GitHub-side artifacts with no knowledge of the bot KV label store. Fixes: (1) manual deletion surfaced — every /tasks row now carries a delete button routed through the existing task:del -> task:delconfirm -> removeTask flow, and the task view offers Delete for terminal AND unreadable-status tasks; (2) automatic reclamation via new scripts/reclaim-stale-task-labels.mjs running hourly as the task-label-reclamation job of cleanup.yml — it scans user:<chat>:tasks KV docs via wrangler CLI and frees labels whose job is stale under the SAME rule as expired.py (expires_at_epoch past, terminal state, or no readable status); credentials referenced by secret name only (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN/CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, same pair as deploy-bots.yml); (3) label reuse — ensureTaskLabel now picks the lowest currently-unused letter instead of incrementing forever; (4) /tasks sorts by status.created_at_epoch newest-first (sortTaskEntries), so reused early letters no longer read as old tasks; (5) the one-time legacy cleanup of the operators live KV labels (B,C,G,H,I,J,K,L,M,N) is executed by the same script on the next cleanup.yml run — Cloudflare credentials exist only as repo secrets, so it cannot be run from a build sandbox; this is documented and the first runs report is uploaded as the task-label-reclamation-report artifact.

architecture_concerns.decision_at_stake: Ordering race in the §9.2 relay path: Bot A copied the video into the private relay group at staging time, but the KV relay-job record (putRelayJob) was only created at confirm time. Bot B's webhook (relay-worker.js rememberCopiedMedia) could observe the group-copied media before the record existed, silently drop it (no record to attach bot_b_file_id to), and the later ready-signal then failed with 'send the video again'. Rare, self-healing, no data loss — but a bad user-facing moment. Inherited from the legacy implementation, not introduced by the rewrite.
architecture_concerns.why_i_think_this_needs_attention: The record existed only in the confirm step, so the whole staging→confirm window was a drop window for the copied-media update. Closing it removes the unexplained 'send the video again' resend entirely rather than handling it after the fact.
architecture_concerns.what_i_did_for_now: Fixed: the KV relay-job record is now created at staging time (state 'staged', media coordinates + internal_group_chat_id) BEFORE the group copy/forward call in bot/src/index.js handleWizardRelayVideo; after the copy succeeds the record is updated with internal_group_message_id via a merge that preserves any bot_b_file_id Bot B already attached. startRelayJob (confirm) now upgrades the existing record in place (state 'ready' + sealed_payload) instead of creating it. relay-worker.js rememberCopiedMedia logic unchanged — it simply always finds the record now; it is additionally exported via __test for the regression tests.
architecture_concerns.what_the_right_answer_probably_is: This is the right answer — create-then-copy ordering removes the race at the source. The 'staged' state is not routable: routeReadyMarker's sealedRelayPayload still requires state 'ready' plus sealed_payload, so an early/lone ready marker fails closed exactly as before. No dedup, relevance-gate, or KV write-conditionality logic from the prior KV-quota work was touched (net staging→confirm relay-record KV writes are unchanged: 2).
architecture_concerns.action_requested: None — resolved and verified. 3 new regression tests prove the race is closed (record created at staging lets rememberCopiedMedia attach media before any confirm-time fields exist; pre-fix drop behavior documented; out-of-scope updates still refused).
architecture_concerns.resolution: Moved relay-job record creation from confirm time to staging time in bot/src/index.js (handleWizardRelayVideo creates the record before copyMessage; startRelayJob merges/upgrades it). bot/test/relay.test.mjs +3 tests. Full suites green after change: 210 Python + 78 JS (was 75).
